Select compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism for IC50 activities against human ROR-gamma (CHEMBL1741186). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, and compound_records. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require structures. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1741186 and standard_type IC50. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism.
